main_text.p: Postremo in sacrosancta hac de Iudæorum Regibus Historia, in ipso quasi Epilogo & Catastrophe, maximè insigne & memorabile (excepto solùm illud Davidis) reseruatur obedientiæ exemplum.4.Reg.25.{t} Nabuchadonosor Assyriorum Rex, tum temporis Palestinam totam ferro & flamma vastaret, Hieroso-lymam expugnaret, Templum vnà cum palatio Regis incenderat, sacratis-sima vasa expilauerat, cætera militibus (qui cædes stupris,stupra cædibus;mis-cebant) diripienda dedit, Regem ipsum vnà cum filijs (postquam exoculasset) trucidauit, vrbem denique totam, & mœnia solo exæquauit; postremò, populi reliquias, quæ tantæ cladi super-fuerant, in miserrimam seruitutem ab-duxit. Neque adhuc satis sibi factum ratus, suam statuam ex auro conflari, ac in loco publico ab omnibus adorari, quoties tuba exaudiretur : recusantes in ardenti fornaci viuos concremari iuss-sit. Haec cùm in Iudaeam fuissent allata, sanctissimi Prophetae ad captiuos literas dederunt, vt nihilominùs u Baruch.1. Ierem.29.{u} Pro Na-buchodonosoris, liberorumq; eius salute, vota

page.notes: The left margin shows fragments of the facing left-hand page and is not transcribed. The text runs on past the bottom edge of this part. The cut-off top of the margin shows only faint marks, unreadable: [illegible, ~5 letters] at the top right and [illegible, ~4 letters] beside the middle of the column. The line "iuss-sit" is doubtful: the scan shows "iuf-fit" at the line end, and I read long s as s, so [?] would apply. The mark "u" in the text is a superscript reference and is not printed as a word. The abbreviation "q;" after "liberorum" is faint.
